English.Char_Desc_45: Find out where your disk space went

English.Char_Desc_250: DiskGeek scans any folder or drive and shows exactly where the space went - a sortable list, a squarified treemap, exact and near-duplicate detection, and snapshots to compare over time. Free, with no Pro tier.
English.Char_Desc_450: DiskGeek scans any folder or drive and shows exactly where the disk space went. It offers a sortable list view, a squarified treemap that makes the largest consumers obvious at a glance, byte-for-byte and perceptual-hash duplicate detection, similar-image detection, and snapshots so two scans can be compared over time. Scanning runs on a background thread with a live counter and a Cancel button. Free, with no Pro tier, no ads and no bundled offers.
English.Char_Desc_2000:
DiskGeek scans any folder or drive and shows exactly where the disk space went.
A sortable list view is the fastest way to see what is biggest. A squarified treemap makes the largest consumers obvious at a glance. Duplicate detection works byte for byte and, for images, by perceptual hash, so near-identical photographs are found as well as exact copies. Snapshots let two scans be compared over time.
Scanning runs on a background thread with a live file, folder and byte counter and a Cancel button, so the interface never locks up even on very large volumes.
No Pro tier, no ads and no bundled offers. Windows 10 1809 or later, 64-bit. Free to use, including at work.
